features.name: API queries in MCP server
features.description: Support for API queries in MCP server, which serve as the foundation for Power BI apps in Business Central. Now available for external agents to include aggregations and analytics.
features.status_evidence_quote: API queries are the foundation for our Power BI apps, and this is now available in Business Central uh MCP server
caveats: APIs available in version 22.28.2 and later
Only the highest numbered API version should be selected for use

features.name: Analytics API reference documentation
features.description: Documentation for analytics APIs including how they are used in Power BI apps, with semantic models and calculations documented. Includes guidance on use cases across functional areas.
caveats: Documentation covers use cases across multiple functional areas including manufacturing, sales, and finance

features.name: MCP server configuration for object type query
features.description: MCP server configuration now supports selecting query as object type, with access to all analytics API queries grouped under the API group analytics. Includes GL account category, finance, and inventory related APIs.
caveats: API versions shown include version 0.5 and version 1 for backwards compatibility
Users should select the highest numbered API version

quotes.why_it_matters: States the main benefit: external agents can now use the analytics API queries.
